theme_and_archetype.archetype: Neo-Brutalist Soft Play (Variation of Archetype 3 + Archetype 6)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Playful, joyful, modern, energetic, creative, approachable
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Appeals to creators and designers without feeling like a boring B2B SaaS. Hard black borders mix with soft pastels to avoid looking childish while remaining energetic.

design_principles: Neo-Brutalism + Pastel: Sharp hard-edged black borders mixed with vibrant, soft pastel backgrounds.
Asymmetry creates tension: Use offset bento grids and avoid center-aligning everything.
Editorial Motion: Use a slow marquee for integrations (Slack, Trello, Jira) instead of a standard grid.
Generous Spacing: Heavy padding inside containers so text breathes alongside hard borders.

rules: Headings never use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts.
Never center text by default; align left for readability in brutalist setups.
Use mono font for overlines, labels, and specific extension details.
Do NOT use teal green (#1B93A4) or generic purple-blue gradients.
Buttons/CTAs should be vivid yellow or pink with black text and hard black shadows.
Borders should always be pure or near black (#0F0F0F).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind scale (p-4, p-8, p-12, p-20, p-32)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Generous spacing. Any container with a border must have p-6 or p-8.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A 'Tetris' Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps, asymmetrical spans).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B 'Control Room' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3, dense, full height).
general: Asymmetry is preferred over perfect symmetry.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Only use for floating AI assistant or sticky header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b-2 border-[#0F0F0F]).

components.buttons: Shadcn components heavily modified: solid bright colors, black borders, hard offset shadows.
components.cards: Bento style. Varied background pastel colors (yellow, mint, pink) with black borders.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs with border-2 border-[#0F0F0F] focus:ring-0 focus:border-vivid_tangerine shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(15,15,15,1)].
components.ai_widget: Floating panel bottom right. Solid pastel background, hard black border, icon-heavy.
components.annotation_editor: A full-width canvas area. Toolbar floating at bottom or left side with monochromatic or bright icon buttons.
components.integrations_marquee: Continuous slow scrolling marquee (react-fast-marquee) for Trello, Jira, Slack, Gmail.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Bold weight) or lucide-react with high stroke-width.

hero_abstract_shapes.description: Abstract joyful 3D shapes on vivid yellow background
hero_abstract_shapes.usage: Marketing page hero background or feature accent image.

feature_camera_chat.description: Playful modern 3D illustration of a video camera and chat bubble

creative_workspace.usage: Use in 'For Creators & Teams' block or Dashboard empty state background.

creator_smiling_1.description: Young woman with headphones working on laptop
creator_smiling_1.usage: Testimonial section or Demo user avatar.

creator_smiling_2.description: Young woman working on laptop in modern office
creator_smiling_2.usage: Feature section for 'Direct integrations with Slack/Jira'.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons press down (translate down/right, reduce shadow). High contrast changes.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Ensure focus rings are highly visible (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid App (Marketing + SaaS Dashboard). Output code in .jsx or .js as per the current environment (not .tsx).
Ensure proper routing (e.g. '/' for marketing, '/dashboard' for app, '/recording/:id' for detail view).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layout bento grids, avoiding rigid generic components.
Implement neo-brutalism: All buttons, cards, and input fields MUST have 'border-2 border-[#0F0F0F]' and a hard drop shadow 'shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#0F0F0F]'.
For the integrations marquee, use react-fast-marquee or CSS animations. Make the text/logos large.
CRITICAL: Include 'data-testid' attribute on ALL interactive and key informational elements.
Use the provided media URLs exclusively. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Do NOT use teal (#1B93A4) or purple (#9D4CDD) slop.
AI widget should be a floating interface with upload capability and chat UI.
